notation:
# Snowflake reference for the spine rules (SPEC_NOTES N5/P7): the "Fern" preset of the snowflake designer.
# Not a canonical fixture: only its spring network (and one growth placement) is pinned, lab vs app.
title: Fern snowflake
terms: US
yarn: thread-10
hook: 1.5mm
params: thread-10_1.5mm
source: generated by the snowflake designer (guided, 6 points)
license: CC0-1.0
notes: Stiffen and pin out over the blocking template: tips at 4.4 cm from the centre, valleys at 1.9 cm (about 8.7 cm across the points). The last round is a pointed round, judged by blocking, not by the flatness rule.

Rnd 1: ch 7, join to form ring, ch 6 (counts as dc, ch 3), *dc in ring, ch 3* x5, join. (6 dc, 6 ch-3 sps)
Rnd 2: sl st in next ch-3 sp, ch 1, sc in same sp, ch 2, sc in same sp, ch 2, *sc in next ch-3 sp, ch 2, sc in same sp, ch 2* x5, join. (12 sc, 12 ch-2 sps)
Rnd 3: sl st in next ch-2 sp, ch 5 (counts as dc, ch 2), dc in same sp, ch 2, sc in next ch-2 sp, ch 2, *(dc, ch 2, dc) in next ch-2 sp, ch 2, sc in next ch-2 sp, ch 2* x5, join. (18 sts, 18 ch-2 sps)
Rnd 4: sl st in next ch-2 sp, ch 1, (sc, ch 16, sl st in 4th ch from hook, sl st in next 3 ch, picot, picot, sl st in next 3 ch, ch-4 picot, ch-4 picot, sl st in next 3 ch, ch-5 picot, ch-5 picot, sl st in next 3 ch, sc) in same sp, ch 11, sk next ch-2 sp, sk next ch-2 sp, *(sc, ch 16, sl st in 4th ch from hook, sl st in next 3 ch, picot, picot, sl st in next 3 ch, ch-4 picot, ch-4 picot, sl st in next 3 ch, ch-5 picot, ch-5 picot, sl st in next 3 ch, sc) in next ch-2 sp, ch 11, sk next ch-2 sp, sk next ch-2 sp* x5, join, fasten off. (12 sc, 36 picot, 6 ch-11 sps)
